objective: Freeze and independently review the cheapest deterministic matched-mean apparatus experiment before any implementation or execution.

candidates.title: Matched-mean decoder, seed/rank, exact-law, and eta-aware estimator fixture
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the repaired inference apparatus can regenerate and decode two equal-mean deterministic streams and recover their pre-registered one-third Boolean-gamma separation under exact bounded semantics.
candidates.positive_decision: Freeze a PASS-reviewed experiment specification and authorize only a separately opened implementation-review batch.
candidates.negative_decision: Record NO-GO or a scoped design obstruction; no mathematical negative about ECDLP follows.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Record REVISE and the cheapest exact repair; do not implement or execute.
candidates.next_action: Open a fresh immutable design-repair batch for the four blocking review findings, snapshot the successor bytes, and obtain a new independent design review before implementation consideration.

ambiguities.question: Does design PASS authorize implementation or execution?
ambiguities.resolution: No. It authorizes at most a separately opened and independently reviewed implementation task.
ambiguities.basis: DEC-20260809-fd955a and this batch claim ceiling.

candidates.dominated_by: This is an apparatus-control design, not an attack candidate; Pollard rho remains the security baseline.

sota_delta.note: Design only; no algorithmic improvement is measured or claimed.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Immutable strict-YAML experiment specification plus one fresh independent review-adversarial verdict bound to its snapshot.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: REVISE preserves non-execution and names one bounded repair.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any undefined key, rank, exact law, decoder, estimator, resource, artifact, stopping, or invalidation semantic is REVISE rather than inferred PASS.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The independent review and Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Native design and independent review inference; no experiment computation.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: The design is bounded by exact integer stream and estimator schemas rather than curve computation.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One active role at a time; archival tasks run alone.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one design, one independent verdict, and one ledger disposition, or immediately on integrity failure.

stages.purpose: Validate and snapshot the control plane.
stages.dominant_operation: Schema, focus, dispatch, ledger, and Git checks.
stages.stop_rule: Stop if any opening or archive gate fails.

stages.dominant_operation: Exact decoder, seed/rank, law, estimator, and resource specification.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after the two declared artifacts or on budget exhaustion.

stages.dominant_operation: Recompute laws, expected values, schemas, budgets, and claim boundaries.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after one PASS, REVISE, or NO-GO report.

stages.purpose: Checkpoint and ledger-archive the bounded disposition.
stages.dominant_operation: Exact-path hashing, commits, and repository validation.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on any integrity mismatch; otherwise after the verified ledger archive.

claims.statement: A fully specified deterministic matched-mean fixture can cheaply falsify the proposal's inference apparatus before any curve or selector is built.
claims.scope: Experiment design and independent design review only.
claims.target_result: An immutable experiment specification and an independent PASS, REVISE, or NO-GO verdict.
claims.observed_result: Independent REVISE: all planted arithmetic recomputes, but the gamma-gap statistic, canonical serialization, X/Y/V decoder interface, and stage/resource/artifact closure require a versioned successor design.
